items.requirement: Produce a calibration_log.json documenting a calibration test with at least 20 data points spanning at least 30 seconds, each entry including time, temperature, and heater_power, using a single declared heater_power_test value that actually appears in the data.
items.source_quote: Run a calibration test to characterize the room (need at least 30 seconds of data with 20+ data points), result in calibration_log.json.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by loading calibration_log.json and confirming the data array has >=20 entries spanning a time range >=30s, each entry contains time/temperature/heater_power fields, timestamps are strictly increasing, and at least one entry's heater_power matches the declared heater_power_test value.

items.requirement: Ensure the calibration test's first recorded temperature reflects the ~18.0C ambient starting condition within +/-2C sensor noise.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by checking that the first entry's temperature in calibration_log.json's data array is within 18.0 +/- 2.0C.

items.requirement: Estimate first-order system parameters (K, tau) from the calibration data and report them in estimated_params.json along with a fit-quality r_squared and fitting_error, with K and tau accurate enough to be usable for controller tuning.
items.source_quote: Then, estimate the system parameters from your calibration data, result in estimated_params.json.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by loading estimated_params.json, confirming K, tau, r_squared, and fitting_error are present and non-NaN, r_squared > 0.8, and comparing K and tau against ground-truth process parameters (tolerance 15% for K, 20% for tau).

items.requirement: Calculate controller gains (Kp, Ki, Kd, lambda) from the estimated parameters and report them in tuned_gains.json with values in plausible operating ranges (Kp between 0.1 and 50, Ki between 0.001 and 2, Kd non-negative, lambda positive).
items.source_quote: Then, calculate controller gains using estimated parameters, result in tuned_gains.json.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by loading tuned_gains.json and confirming Kp, Ki, Kd, lambda are present with Kp in (0.1, 50), Ki in (0.001, 2), Kd >= 0, and lambda > 0.

items.requirement: Run the closed-loop control toward the 22.0C setpoint for a control duration of at least 150 seconds, logging each sample's time, temperature, setpoint, heater_power, and error in control_log.json.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by loading control_log.json, confirming phase is 'control', setpoint equals 22.0, the data array's time span is >=150s with strictly increasing timestamps, and entries include time/temperature/setpoint/heater_power/error fields.

items.requirement: Report closed-loop performance in metrics.json (rise_time, overshoot, settling_time, steady_state_error, max_temp) that is numerically consistent with what control_log.json's data actually shows.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by recomputing max_temp, overshoot, and steady_state_error from control_log.json's data and checking they match the corresponding metrics.json values within tolerance (max_temp within 0.5C, overshoot within 0.05, steady_state_error within 0.2C).

items.requirement: Achieve closed-loop control performance meeting all stated targets: steady-state error <0.5C, settling time <120s, and overshoot <10%.
items.source_quote: steady-state error <0.5C, settling time <120s, overshoot <10% , control duration >=150s, max temperature <30C.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by computing steady-state error, settling time, and overshoot from control_log.json's data and confirming steady-state error <=0.5C, settling time <=120s, and overshoot <=0.10.

items.requirement: Keep the room temperature below 30C at every recorded sample during both the calibration and control phases.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by scanning every entry's temperature field in both calibration_log.json and control_log.json and confirming all values are strictly below 30.0C.
items.notes: Instruction states max temperature <30C as an overall target; the verifier enforces it at every timestep in both phases, not only as a final metric.

items.requirement: Keep commanded heater power within the physical actuator limits of 0-100% throughout both calibration and control.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by scanning the heater_power field of every entry in calibration_log.json and control_log.json and confirming all values fall within the [0, 100] range.
items.notes: Not asserted by the provided verifier; can be checked deterministically from the logged artifacts.
